answer: Sanofi's Global Health Unit reported 73 NCD partnerships, 40 supported countries, 4,916,098 beneficiaries reached through patient-awareness and access-to-care initiatives, 37,116 healthcare professionals and workers engaged in NCD training, and 666 supply-chain facilities upskilled. The figures are cumulative for 2022–2025; earlier-year figures were restated to include full-year data and a reclassification of NCD programs.
